text: Yes. Worried about making a start somewhere new, of course. She kept asking whether they’d expect her to work faster.
direction: Maggie Shaw, an adult London garment worker. Warm mid-register woman voice with a subtle working London accent; guarded concern and plain speaking. Full warm middle mezzo with a firm forward edge, stronger consonant attacks and a more direct rhythm than Nora. Let concern soften phrase endings without making every line tremulous or tearful.
